episodes.synopsis: Spearhead awakens to find themselves in a strange new land, while Lena continues her battles as a Handler.
episodes.title: Welcome

episodes.synopsis: The members of Spearhead are given a brief respite from the war. But is it alright for them to enjoy themselves when so many have fallen?
episodes.title: It's Too Late

episodes.synopsis: The crew of Spearhead find themselves back on the battlefield, as the tide of the war turns against the Federacy.
episodes.title: Glad to Be Here

episodes.synopsis: The members of Spearhead are reunited as a massive Legion offensive looms. With the next deadly phase of the war almost here, how will they spend their remaining hours?
episodes.title: Welcome Back

episodes.synopsis: The Legion's large-scale offensive begins, and the Spearhead crew are sent into the thick of the fighting. But even back at base, there's no safety to be found...
episodes.title: Even So

episodes.synopsis: As the war with the Legion rages on, the enemy makes a final march towards the Republic of San Magnolia. Lena waits to stop them, but...
episodes.title: I Won't Forget

episodes.synopsis: The team prepares for a final suicide mission against "Morpho," a massive railgun Legion capable of single-handedly turning the tide of the battle.
episodes.title: The Truth Is

episodes.synopsis: Nordlicht finds themselves up against a massive foe in the middle of enemy territory, with no hope of escape and no reinforcements coming to help.
episodes.title: Stay This Way Forever

episodes.synopsis: Deep in enemy territory, with supplies running low and damage piling up, Nordlicht makes a final desperate march towards Morpho.
episodes.title: Together Unto Death

episodes.synopsis: The members of Nordlicht drop out one by one in the face of the Legion's onslaught, and Shin is left to face the Morpho alone.
episodes.title: All That's Left

episodes.synopsis: At the end of it all and left behind once more, Shin is at the brink. Just then, someone appears, in a sea of red flowers...
episodes.title: Shin

episodes.synopsis: The operation to destroy the Morpho was a success, and Shin and his team fulfilled their promise to return to the Federacy alive. After enjoying a brief respite, they once again wished to serve in frontline units, but they received a certain notice from Ernst. After crossing the deadly battlefields of the Republic, they arrived at a new meeting in the Federacy. They fight, suffer, and see a ray of hope. This is a story of boys and girls who have begun to move little by little. At the end of their journey, what is reflected in their eyes?
episodes.title: Handler One
